recalls.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2008-2011 Titan, Frontier, Xterra, Pathfinder, Armada, and 2008-2009 Quest vehicles.  The resin emblem on the driver's air bag cover may develop cracks and detach during air bag deployment.

source: NHTSA (api.nhtsa.gov) — complaints and recalls by vehicle
